results.title: The Desktop in Termux:X11
results.text: Termux:X11 is only published on GitHub (it isn't on F-Droid or the Play Store). Open its [nightly release page](https://github.com/termux/termux-x11/releases/tag/nightly), download **`termux-x11-universal-debug.apk`**, and install it. It needs Android 8 or newer (on Android 7, use [VNC](/termux/vnc) instead), and works with every current Termux build (F-Droid, GitHub and Play Store).

results.title: The Desktop Is Black, Slow or Closes
results.section: Termux:X11 doesn't open, or a box covers the desktop
results.text:
- **A "send you notifications?" box** (Android 13 and newer, the first time): tap **Allow**. Your desktop is behind it.
- **Termux says "Desktop is running" but the app doesn't come to the front:** open Termux:X11 from your app drawer.
- **The extra-keys bar is missing, or covers the bottom panel:** Andronix hides Termux:X11's extra-keys bar the first time you start a desktop so the bottom panel shows. Swipe down with three fingers in Termux:X11 to bring it back (or turn it on in Termux:X11 settings).
- **"Termux:X11 isn't installed":** download `termux-x11-universal-debug.apk` from the [Termux:X11 nightly release](https://github.com/termux/termux-x11/releases/tag/nightly) and install it. See [Start the desktop](/termux/termux-x11).

results.title: Report a Problem
results.text: For example **The install failed**, **Desktop, Termux:X11 or sound**, **Termux stops (signal 9)**, **Modded OS access or download**, **Refund or purchase**, **Something in the app** or **An idea**.

results.title: The Desktop in Termux:X11
results.section: The first time you open it
results.text:
- **On Android 13 and newer**, Android asks **"Allow Termux:X11 to send you notifications?"** on top of the app. Tap **Allow**; your desktop is behind that box.
- Termux shows **Desktop is running** just before the app comes to the front. If Termux:X11 doesn't come to the front by itself, open it from your app drawer.
- Andronix hides Termux:X11's extra-keys bar the first time you start a desktop so the bottom panel shows. Swipe down with three fingers in Termux:X11 to bring it back (or turn it on in Termux:X11 settings).

Keep the Termux session that ran `andronix desktop` open while you use the desktop. Switch between the apps with Android's app switcher instead of closing Termux.

If the Termux:X11 app isn't installed, the command says so and shows the download link.

results.title: The Desktop in Termux:X11
results.text:
**Get the Termux:X11 APK:** it's published only on the Termux project's GitHub. Open the [nightly release](https://github.com/termux/termux-x11/releases/tag/nightly) and download **`termux-x11-universal-debug.apk`**, which works on every processor. Andronix doesn't host or mirror it. Then follow [Set it up once](#set-it-up-once).

This page is for Andronix with **Termux**, on phones that can't run Linux in the app (Android 7, or no 64-bit ARM processor), or if you use the command-line installer. Termux:X11 itself needs Android 8 or newer; on Android 7, use [VNC](/termux/vnc). For Linux in the app, see [The desktop in the app](/desktop/in-the-app).

Termux:X11 is an Android app that shows your distro's desktop full screen on the phone, at the phone's own resolution. There's nothing to connect to and no desktop password to type: one command in Termux opens it.

results.title: The andronix Command
results.text:
```bash
andronix desktop [<distro>]
andronix desktop stop
```

- Opens the distro's desktop full screen in the Termux:X11 app, as your user. With only one desktop install, the distro name is optional.
- Installs Termux's `termux-x11` package the first time. The Termux:X11 app itself comes from its GitHub release page; if it's missing, the command shows the link.
- `andronix desktop stop` (from another Termux session) stops it.

See [Termux:X11](/termux/termux-x11).
